chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa narrated to me, he said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far narrated to me, he said: Ahmad ibn Abdullah narrated to me from Abi al-Jawza' al-Munbih ibn Ubayd Allah, from al-Husayn ibn Alwan, from Umar ibn Khalid, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) visited a man from the descendants of Abd al-Muttalib who was in the burial chamber (siyaq), and he had been turned towards the non-Qiblah direction. He said: 'Turn him towards the Qiblah, for when you do that, the angels turn their faces towards him, and Allah turns towards him, and it remains so until his soul is captured.'

key_terms.السِّیَاق: The burial chamber or grave structure where the body is placed
key_terms.الْقِبْلَهِ: The direction of prayer (Qiblah), specifically towards the Kaaba in Mecca
key_terms.یُقْبَضَ: Is captured (referring to the extraction of the soul)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and spiritual benefit of facing the deceased towards the Qiblah?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith from Imam Ali (AS) via the Prophet (PBUH) establishes the Sunnah of orienting the deceased's face toward the Qiblah to invite divine mercy and angelic attention during the critical moment of soul extraction (*qabd*). This practice underscores the continuity of spiritual connection between the living, the angels, and Allah at the threshold of death, reflecting the Shia emphasis on ritual precision as a means of securing favorable divine gaze.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Musa who said it was narrated to me by Abdillah b. Ja’far who said it was narrated to me by Ahmad b. Abdillah from Abi al-Jawzaa’ al-Munabih b. ’Ubayd-Allah from al-Hussain b. Alwan from Umar b. Khalid from Zayd b. Ali from his father from his grandfather from Ameer al-Mumineen (a.s.) who said:
“If you turn his face towards qiblah, angels and God look at him till his soul is captured.”
